title: aeonium × laxiflorum
intro: Aeonium × laxiflorum, commonly known as the Laxiflorum Aeonium or Tree Aeonium, is a hybrid succulent plant that belongs to the family Crassulaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aeonium × laxiflorum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions.
